items.headline: Massive Nationwide Protests Erupt Across France Over Rising Living Costs
items.summary: Over 550,000 people demonstrated across France on Saturday to protest rising living costs and education grievances, resulting in clashes with police and nearly 400 arrests. The nationwide rallies mark one of the country's largest waves of social unrest in recent years and have put intense political pressure on the French government.

items.headline: China Proposes New Export Controls Targeting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Technologies
items.summary: China has introduced proposed export restrictions covering 40 critical technologies, including 23 related to artificial intelligence systems such as large models and autonomous agents. The development is making headlines now as immediate registration rules take effect while officials collect public feedback on the policy.

items.headline: Milwaukee Brewers Sweep Dodgers to Advance to World Series
items.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers completed a four-game sweep of the two-time defending champion Los Angeles Dodgers with a 6-4 victory in Game 4 of the National League Championship Series. The victory marks Milwaukee's first National League pennant and World Series appearance in 44 years while ending Los Angeles's bid for a three-peat.

items.headline: Dancing with the Stars Suspends Val Chmerkovskiy Over Social Media Post
items.summary: Longtime professional dancer Val Chmerkovskiy was handed a one-week suspension by producers after making a social media post referencing the 2022 Oscars slap toward judge Carrie Ann Inaba. The disciplinary action marks the first official dancer suspension in the reality show's history and forces him to sit out the upcoming live episode.
